cases.description: INDIRECT could not resolve to a reference (no such sheet), so ISREF is FALSE -- the basis of the IF(ISREF(...)) guard pattern
cases.expected_note: Microsoft documents ISREF as TRUE when value refers to a reference and FALSE otherwise; an unresolvable INDIRECT yields no reference: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/is-functions-0f2d7971-6019-40a0-a171-f2d869135665

cases.description: INDIRECT resolves to a real cell reference on the current sheet, so ISREF is TRUE
cases.expected_note: Microsoft documents ISREF as TRUE when value refers to a reference: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/office/is-functions-0f2d7971-6019-40a0-a171-f2d869135665
